results.code_info: Lot #25339, 26037, and 26057.   Best By Dates: 12/5/2026, 8/6/2027, and 8/27/2027 is marked on the side of the case. However, these best before dates are for the cases while the product is frozen.   Once an individual unit is moved out of the case and into refrigeration the shelf life is 45-days. Therefore, the consumer of an individual unit will not see the best before dates associated with a case of frozen product.   Direct consignees were instructed to add a best before date to an individual unit based on the date moved from a freezer to a refrigerator.
